{{Youmay|a mechanism to lock [[Binders/Legends|binders]]|the [[ID scanner|scanner]] used by the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]]}}
An '''identity scanner''' was a type of [[Lock/Legends|locking]] mechanism. It was one of several methods that could be used to secure [[Binders/Legends|binders]].<ref name="EGWT">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref>
